body:
Fixes #1013.

The `something else…` row is a box — the one place on a question a person types
an answer of their own — and `questionOtherKey` routed its keys by hand, binding
only a short list. So `cmd+←`/`cmd+→` never reached the ends of the line,
`cmd+delete` never killed to the line's start, and `opt+delete`/`ctrl+delete`
never deleted a word: the chords worked in the message box under the answer and
were silently dead in the answer. It is the defect `editkeys.go` was written for,
said about a box that had grown its own map.

**Fix.** The motions now go through `editorMotion` and the word kill through
`editorWordKill` — the one vocabulary every other box on the surface reads — and
kill-to-start is read under the two names the message box already binds
(`ctrl+u`, `super+backspace`). `ctrl+w` is deliberately still not the word kill
here: it shuts the tab in front everywhere on this surface, the same bargain the
message box makes.

- `internal/tui3/question.go` — replace the hand-rolled motion/word-kill cases
  with the shared vocabulary; add the line kill.
- `internal/tui3/questionchords_test.go` — the answer box takes the three word
  names, the two line-end names, and both word kills. Red before the fix
  (`ctrl+left was not taken…`, `ctrl+u did not kill…`), green after.
- `internal/manual/chat/questions.md` — the box's paragraph now says what its
  editing keys do (the manual law).
- `docs/changes/unreleased/1013-question-answer-box-chords.md`.

**Verified.** `go test ./internal/tui3/ -run Question` passes; `make test-quick`
(build, vet, fmt, packed corpus, changelog, manual gates, laws — the whole tree)
is green.

title: tui3: a question's own answer box reads the shared editing vocabulary (#1013)
